rows.hypothesis: Adaptive recurrence should use multiple causal/control signals and expected marginal utility.
rows.strongest_counter: A fixed small recurrence budget matches or beats it once false halts, runtime variance and policy complexity are counted.
rows.discriminator: Pinned real 4B matched-seed fixed-vs-adaptive A/B with accuracy, false halt, recurrence, token, latency, rollback and resource distributions.

rows.hypothesis: Hyperposition should preserve unresolved alternatives as first-class state when future projections can diverge.
rows.strongest_counter: Explicit scalar/LWW arbitration is sufficient and cheaper for most lanes.
rows.discriminator: Matched replay under conflict/revocation/crash; compare downstream decisions, provenance, recovery and cost with explicit arbitration policy.

rows.hypothesis: Truthful outcome reentry improves control through causal credit.
rows.strongest_counter: Observed gains are correlation or extra-compute effects rather than the reentry path itself.
rows.discriminator: Truthful/shuffled/delayed/no-reentry factorial plus path lesion at matched compute; measure downstream state deltas and outcomes.

rows.strongest_counter: Stage presence or global integration is sufficient; receipt machinery only adds bookkeeping.
rows.discriminator: Preserve stage labels while lesioning receiver-use/effect/reentry edges; blinded cross-implementation validator and task outcomes.

rows.hypothesis: V20 word-boundary priority can simplify relation parsing without semantic loss.
rows.strongest_counter: Regex word-boundary is not the language's identifier boundary and steals V17-valid dotted/hyphen/postfix qids.
rows.discriminator: Execute the qid-continuation falsifier and full strict semantic discriminator on exact V20 bytes; any V17-valid semantic mismatch refutes exact V20.

rows.hypothesis: Direct parser/canonicalizer construction parity is required for WP02 identity.
rows.strongest_counter: Independent suites are sufficient even if construction options differ internally.
rows.discriminator: Cross-feed identical corpus through both production and standalone paths under identical options; compare normalized AST/hash and error classification.

rows.hypothesis: Pulse S2 may cancel net-zero content chains only with an identity-stability witness.
rows.strongest_counter: Equal final content is sufficient because downstream consumers are content-addressed only.
rows.discriminator: A->B->A sequential-vs-batched replay with versioned target_record_id, SPM bytes/hashes, crash/restart and real Pulse trace.

rows.hypothesis: Typed/multitimescale reward state improves control after verified outcome and causal credit.
rows.strongest_counter: A scalar causal outcome value plus simple homeostatic/safety gates performs equally with lower complexity.
rows.discriminator: Historical baseline vs scalar vs typed vs typed+multihorizon matched replay under conflicting task/safety/resource outcomes, OOD, lesion/rescue and restart.

rows.hypothesis: Query-aware EAP damping improves retrieval without corrupting counterevidence access.
rows.strongest_counter: Lexical/query conditioning suppresses low-overlap refutations and creates confirmation bias.
rows.discriminator: Explicit REFUTES/COUNTEREVIDENCE/CONTRADICTS plus negated/false-query controls; measure counterevidence recall, task accuracy, latency and graph work.

rows.hypothesis: External capability/gateway verification must remain outside generative model syntax.
rows.strongest_counter: A sufficiently constrained grammar can safely self-authorize effects.
rows.discriminator: Replay/nonce/expiry/authority-substitution and forged-capability attacks at final gateway; fail closed if independent authority is absent.
